_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for NVDA retrospectives (retro/build_nvda.py), generated from NVIDIA's own filings: every raw figure is the row string it appears in (kept in 'rows'), checked against its filing, and every growth rate, margin and rule-T value is computed from those figures. Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date (EDGAR's acceptance time; after the 16:00 ET close, the next trading day; before 2002 the filing date). Per-share figures are on the share basis of their filing ('share_basis' where it predates the filing); the builder restates them for the splits effective by AS_OF.

history_vintages.why: 'NVIDIA Corporation is the worldwide leader in programmable graphics processor technologies.' 'The market for GPUs, MCPs and handheld GPUs application processors is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change, evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.' 'We expect substantial competition from Intel’s publicized focus on moving to selling platform solutions dominated by Intel products, such as when Intel achieved success with its Centrino platform solution.' 'Our business is cyclical in nature and an industry downturn could harm our financial results.' (FY2007 10-K); CYCLICAL on the 10-K's own words for its business (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json covers a CPU and a GPU integrated on one chip, so those words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)
